data.one_liner: State management powered by get_it to observe changes and rebuild widgets automatically.
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter widgets to observe changes of objects inside the get_it service locator and automatically rebuild when data changes. It eliminates boilerplate builders like ValueListenableBuilder and StreamBuilder.
use_when: You are already using get_it for dependency injection and want reactive UI updates
You want to avoid widget tree nesting and boilerplate builders
avoid_when: You prefer built-in Flutter mechanisms like InheritedWidget or setState
You cannot follow the strict watch ordering rules
strengths: Zero boilerplate with no builders or manual subscriptions
Automatic disposal of subscriptions when widgets are destroyed
Type safe with compile-time error checking via generics
weaknesses: Requires strict adherence to watch ordering rules (index-based retrieval)
Tight coupling with get_it service locator
data.setup_notes: Requires adding watch_it and get_it to pubspec.yaml.
